name: ltx-russian
set:
2D hand-drawn animated film in the manner of a gothic storybook: confident clean ink outlines, cel-shaded colour over painted gouache textures, richly detailed backgrounds, warm amber firelight against the cold blue of a rainy night, deep soft shadows, fluid full animation at 24 frames. England, 1902.

Medium close-up of Mr White standing before the fire, holding up a small dried monkey's paw in his right fist. He says loudly and clearly in Russian: "Я хочу двести фунтов!" Then silence, only the fire crackling and rain. Mr White is a thin man of sixty with a bald crown, grey hair at the sides, a long grey moustache and small round spectacles, in a dark green knitted cardigan over a white collarless shirt, brown trousers and slippers. No text or captions.
